config.notes: Flat JSON object, nlohmann::json written with 4-space indent via a .config.json.tmp file. Keys are the dotted ConfigVar names (e.g. "game.bloomMode") as single top-level keys, not nested. Enums are stored as integers, bools as JSON bools. Only values that were set are written (a value set to its default stays), missing = source default. Read once at start-up; the app rewrites the whole file when any setting changes, so force-stop before editing. Root-only path (owned by the app uid, mode 600).

controller_ports.notes: Binary port-to-controller assignment (80 bytes). Do not edit.

controller_map.notes: Binary per-controller button map for the Thor pad (303 bytes). Edit in the app's controller config UI only.

internal_resolution.label: Graphics Tuner > Internal Resolution
internal_resolution.notes: Range 0-12 step 1 (GraphicsSetting bind 0,12). 0 = Auto = render at the surface size. Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

shadow_resolution.label: Graphics Tuner > Shadow Resolution
shadow_resolution.notes: Range 1-8. Dusklight preset sets 4. Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

frame_interpolation.label: Video > Frame Interpolation
frame_interpolation.notes: FrameInterpMode. Older configs may hold a bool (true = Unlimited); loader accepts both. Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

max_frame_rate.label: Video > Framerate Cap
max_frame_rate.notes: 30-540 step 1. Only used when frame interpolation is Capped (UI greys it out otherwise).

lock_aspect.label: Video > Lock Aspect Ratio
lock_aspect.notes: true = keep 4:3/16:9 game aspect instead of filling the window. Classic preset sets true.

fps_overlay.label: Video > FPS Overlay
fps_overlay.notes: Corner in game.fpsOverlayCorner (0 Top Left, 1 Top Right, 2 Bottom Left, 3 Bottom Right).

bloom.label: Graphics Tuner > Bloom
bloom.notes: Source default Dusk(2); the tuner's own reset value is Classic(1). Strength in game.bloomMultiplier (float 0.0-1.0, UI 0-100% step 10). Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

depth_of_field.label: Graphics Tuner > Depth of Field
depth_of_field.notes: Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

resampler.label: Graphics Tuner > Resampler
resampler.notes: Downscale filter used when internal resolution exceeds the output.

menu_scaling.label: Menu Scaling
menu_scaling.notes: Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

graphics_backend.label: Graphics Backend
graphics_backend.notes: Restart required. Source also knows d3d11/d3d12/metal/opengl/webgpu/null; only backends Aurora reports as available are shown (Vulkan and OpenGL ES expected on Android, not checked).

autosave.label: Auto Save
autosave.notes: Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

instant_saves.label: Instant Saves
instant_saves.notes: Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

fast_climbing.notes: Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

gyro_aim.notes: Sensitivity game.gyroSensitivityX/Y (float, 1.0), smoothing 0.65, deadband 0.04. Value seen in a config.json the app wrote after applying the Dusklight preset; effect not tested in game.

skip_prelaunch.label: Skip Pre-Launch UI
skip_prelaunch.notes: true = boot straight into the game from Cocoon.
